summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $200M of common stock through agent R.F. Lafferty. The filing updates risk factor and dilution disclosure from the May 1, 2026 prospectus supplement. Shares are sold at prevailing market prices with a 0.75% commission; settlement occurs on the first trading day after sale via DTC. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is present.
